title: HTML, CSS & responsive UI
summary: Learn the browser platform before a framework so you can reason about semantics, layout, accessibility and rendering.
why: Learn the browser platform before a framework so you can reason about semantics, layout, accessibility and rendering.

Implement a small working example of HTML, CSS & responsive UI
Debug a realistic failure related to HTML, CSS & responsive UI
